name: ship-pr
description: Ships uncommitted work end to end: branch, commit, PR, an ADR when the change is architecturally significant, and a merge that only happens after you explicitly confirm it. A Stop hook nudges you when work is left unshipped, without acting on its own. Also adds /issues, /actions, /prs, /pr and /repo commands that open the matching GitHub or GitLab view via gh or glab.
